purpose: Pins the supported Claude Code baseline request shape for session/subagent reasoning effort through the Anthropic Messages gateway path (#70). The decoder is based on this pinned shape, not an assumed field name.

deliberateFields.thinking.type: Evidenced control: session/subagent reasoning mode (enabled | adaptive | disabled). Continued from the existing decoder behavior.
deliberateFields.effort: Optional documented additive field carrying subagent/session effort (low|medium|high|xhigh|max). When absent, no source effort is assumed; the canonical ReasoningRequest keeps sourceEffort fidelity for same-family exact translation. Other unknown additive fields are deliberately recorded as ignored, never silently consumed.
